title: Chapter 146 — The Post-Delivery Audit
intro: The best stores call within 4 hours to confirm satisfaction.

sections.title: The Post-Delivery Call
sections.content:
Most stores consider the job done when the truck leaves. The best stores call within 4 hours. 'Hi [name], your [appliance] was delivered today. I wanted to make sure everything went smoothly. Is the unit working well? Did the team take care of the installation? Anything I should know about?'

What to listen for: hesitation means there is a problem they are not saying. 'It is... fine' is not fine. Probe gently: 'Is there anything that is not quite right? I want to make sure you are 100 percent satisfied.'

sections.title: The 24-Hour and 7-Day Cadence
sections.content:
24-hour check: 'Just checking that everything is still running perfectly after the first full day.' 7-day check: 'It has been a week — how are you liking the [appliance]? Any features you have questions about?'

These calls generate more revenue through referrals and reviews than any marketing campaign you will ever run. The customer is excited about their new appliance during this window — capitalize on that excitement.

sections.title: Turning Satisfaction Into Revenue
sections.content:
At the 7-day check: 'Glad you are loving it! If anyone you know is shopping for appliances, I would love the chance to help them. And if you have a minute, a quick Google review would mean a lot — I will text you the link.'

Two requests, back to back, at the peak of satisfaction. This is the highest-converting referral and review ask you will ever make.
